subject: Re: Follow-up: IAM & SOC2 evidence (SSO/SCIM/RBAC) - Ceres Health
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sam Price <sam.price@cereshealth.com>, Tara Liu <tara.liu@cereshealth.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 10 Jun 2026 15:22:00 +0000
Subject: Follow-up: IAM & SOC2 evidence (SSO/SCIM/RBAC) - Ceres Health

Hi Sam / Tara —

Thanks again for the time today — great conversation and appreciate the clear security checklist from your side. Per our call, I wanted to recap agreed next steps and the specific IAM/security artifacts you asked us to provide so your security and procurement teams can continue evaluation.

Quick recap (high level):
- Redwood is SOC 2 Type II (most recent audit 08/2025) and we maintain a Data Processing Addendum and standard breach notification processes.
- We support SSO via SAML 2.0 and OIDC; for provisioning we have SCIM 2.0 support with SCIM tokens scoped to org-level provisioning.
- Our RBAC model provides tenant-level roles (admin, billing_admin, developer, reader) and we can provide an admin-permissions matrix and audit log extracts on request.

Requested artifacts (what Im attaching / will share):
1) Redwood_SOC2_Type2_2025.pdf — our latest SOC 2 Type II report (redacted). Attached.
2) SAML_Metadata.xml — sample IdP/SP metadata, ACS endpoints, certificate thumbprint. Attached.
3) SCIM_API_Spec_v2.pdf — SCIM 2.0 spec and example provisioning flow. Attached.
4) RBAC_Admin_Matrix.xlsx — mapping of roles to permissions and the admin user lifecycle process. Attached.

Questions from your security team that I captured:
- Do we support SCIM groups? (yes, groups via SCIM + group syncing)
- Can audit logs be exported to your SIEM? (we support syslog and S3 export of audit events)
- Retention policy for auth logs? (default 90 days for hosted; configurable for Dedicated/Private)

Next steps / owners:
- Sam/Tara to confirm if the attached redacted SOC2 and RBAC matrix are sufficient for initial approval (Ceres security). 
- If you want a technical deep-dive on SCIM/SAML/SSO, Lauren (cc) can run a 30–45 minute session and share a scoped test tenant.
- Rishi will follow up on k-anonymization questions for PII handling in audit exports if that comes up.

Target timeline: ideally we get approval items clarified by 6/18 so procurement can queue contract redlines.

If you need any additional artifact (DPA, encryption-at-rest details, key management docs) please flag and I’ll prioritize.

Thanks —
Marissa
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0123

Attachments: Redwood_SOC2_Type2_2025.pdf, SAML_Metadata.xml, SCIM_API_Spec_v2.pdf, RBAC_Admin_Matrix.xlsx

From: Sam Price <sam.price@cereshealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Tara Liu <tara.liu@cereshealth.com>
Date: Thu, 11 Jun 2026 09:05:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Follow-up: IAM & SOC2 evidence (SSO/SCIM/RBAC) - Ceres Health

Hi Marissa —

Thanks for the fast follow-up and the attachments — I downloaded the SOC2 report and the SCIM/SAML docs. A couple quick clarifications from our InfoSec side before we kick procurement: 

- SOC2: The redacted report looks fine for now. We may request a bridge letter if the audit window expires before contract signing; procurement will confirm.
- SCIM: Does Redwood support SCIM groups and incremental sync? Also need to confirm if provisioning can be scoped per "environment" (prod vs staging) — we prefer least privilege provisioning per environment.
- SAML: Can you confirm if you support signed assertions and what certificate rotation cadence you recommend?
- Audit logs: We want to confirm retention and whether logs can be pushed to our Splunk instance (syslog or S3).

Happy to do the tech deep-dive. Lauren, can you run through the SCIM group behavior and show an example provisioning flow? We're aiming for a POC tenant to do a basic user provisioning test next week.

Thanks,
Sam
Senior Security Engineer, Ceres Health
sam.price@cereshealth.com | +1 (617) 555-0987

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sam Price <sam.price@cereshealth.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 11 Jun 2026 11:47:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Follow-up: IAM & SOC2 evidence (SSO/SCIM/RBAC) - Ceres Health

Hi Sam —

Happy to run the deep-dive and bring a test tenant. Quick answers inline: 
- SCIM groups: yes, we support SCIM groups and incremental sync (PATCH operations for group membership). We can show group-to-role mapping in the demo.
- Environment scoping: provisioning tokens can be scoped to an "org" and to environment-specific provisioning scopes for Dedicated/Private deployments; for hosted customers we recommend a separate tenant per environment (we'll show options).
- SAML signed assertions: we support signed assertions and recommend rotating SP certs every 12 months; we also support JWK-based rotation for OIDC.
- Audit logs: we can push audit events to your S3 bucket or to your SIEM via syslog; retention is 90 days by default for hosted but can be extended on Dedicated/Private.

Proposed demo slots next week (30–45 mins):
- Tue 6/15 10:00–10:45 PT
- Wed 6/16 13:00–13:45 PT

Sam/Tara: let me know which works and I'll send a calendar invite and a scoped test tenant provisioning guide.

Lauren Bishop
Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com
